name: Indian Emulsifiers Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2020, Indian Emulsifiers 
Ltd is in the business of Manufacturing 
and Supplying of Speciality Chemicals[1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio & Industrial Application[1]
a) Esters - Widely used in lubricants, cosmetics, and personal care products
b) Amphoterics - Common in industrial cleaners and personal care formulations
c) Imidazolines ** - Corrosion inhibitors, emulsifiers, and anti-static agents
d) Phosphate Esters - Flame retardants, anti-wear additives, emulsifiers in metalworking and textile chemicals
e) Wax Emulsions - Coatings, polishes, textiles, and paper finishing
f) SMO & PIBSA Emulsifiers **- Used in oilfield, lubricants, and fuel additives

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 31.6%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
